participation.context: Counted the two turns and left when the prayer was said.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read the prayer, turned the sand-glass twice, and stopped.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Stood the pew with him and took him back across the close.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Gave the responses, short and cold, and did not speak to William.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

story.body: You stood with Mistress Ansell. Master Thwaite turned the glass twice and did not open a new matter. Sir John Spencer answered from his pew and did not look toward you.

title: Stood the prayer while the sand-glass turned twice

participation.context: Confirmed the loaf and the board, and said the writing would stay in the house.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the short loaf and refused to carry a letter.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Left Gib on the stair and off the book.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You ate the short loaf at threepence and went up to write. You gave nobody a letter to carry.
